data.name: Kamanth
data.gender_notes: Kamanth is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kamanth is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘kama’, meaning desire or passion. It is a name that evokes feelings of strong emotions, love, and attachment. In Hindu mythology, Kamadeva, the god of love and desire, is often referred to as Kamanth. The name is also said to bring good fortune and prosperity. The name Kamanth carries the meaning “Desire, Passion, Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kamanth usually hope their child will grow to embody desire, passion, love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kamanth belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desire, Passion, Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kamanth total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kamanth holds significant cultural impact in Hinduism, as it is derived from the god of love and desire, Kamadeva. This god is prominent in Indian mythology and art, and is often depicted as a beautiful, slender man with a bow and arrow, representing the power to ignite love and passion in the hearts of people. The name Kamanth carries a sense of romanticism, allure, and strong emotions, connecting it to the rich and vibrant Hindu cultural tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Kamanth holds spiritual significance as it is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity. historical_references.reference: Kamathas mentioned in the Mahabharata, an ancient Sanskrit epic of India, as one of the eight Vasus (guardians of the directions).
